Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly reframed the comparison to an edge-case polar location, asserting sunrise occurs only once per year there, and used that to conclude full moon is most frequent. The question expects the general/typical frequency, where sunrise happens daily (and continuously somewhere on Earth), far exceeding the frequencies of equinoxes (~2/year), full moons (~12–13/year), and solar eclipses (~2–5/year globally). This misinterpretation led directly to the wrong final answer.
